summary: The task failed verification despite the agent's claim of success. The trace shows the agent followed correct HWPX editing patterns (Python zipfile, placeholder replacement, linesegarray removal) but the verifier still failed. The failure likely stems from missing data fields or incorrect placeholder mapping - the agent only processed 'immediate_actions' but the template may have required additional fields from 'audit_overview.json' like 'audit_items' table data. The existing hwpx-editing skill already covers the technical patterns well, but needs augmentation for safety audit specific workflows: handling severity mapping with Korean annotations, date format conversion (YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY.MM.DD), and explicit guidance on processing all JSON data sections not just obvious placeholders.
